key_fields.sql: select z.locationid, z.borough, z.zone, count(t.pulocationid) as cash_trips from ops.zones z left join lake.trips t on t.pulocationid = z.locationid and t.payment_type = 2 group by z.locationid, z.borough, z.zone order by z.locationid
key_fields.claim: The join condition CAST(PULocationID AS BIGINT) = LocationID forces a per-row cast on the 99k probe rows; aligning the data types of PULocationID and LocationID would eliminate this CPU overhead.

value.sql: SELECT z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone, COUNT(t.PULocationID) AS cash_trips FROM ops.zones z LEFT JOIN lake.trips t ON t.PULocationID::BIGINT = z.LocationID AND t.payment_type = 2 GROUP BY z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone ORDER BY z.LocationID
value.change_summary: Explicitly cast PULocationID to BIGINT in the join condition to match LocationID's type, eliminating the implicit per-row cast on the probe side.
value.risk_notes: If PULocationID contains non-numeric values or values outside BIGINT range, the explicit cast could fail or change semantics; otherwise behavior is identical to the original implicit cast.
